verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Componentwise the same identity, after two notational changes. (i) The paper's vector equation is written in Lean as two scalar interval integrals over φ ∈ [0,1], together with the separately stated period-one periodicity of A and C in φ; the paper writes φ ∈ ℝ/ℤ. (ii) The paper parametrizes the second shear component by -b_s, Lean by the mean tilt m: the Lean right-hand side is a x * m x. With the paper's own t_s = -b_s/a (p. 158, in the hypotheses of Lemma C.1) and m = t_s, a*m = a*t_s = -b_s, so the Lean pair (A, C) is the paper's (a_L, -b_L) and the Lean mean (a x, a x * m x) is the paper's (a, -b_s). (iii) The paper's slow parameters are (X, η) ∈ I × [-1,1]; Lean's are an abstract point x of a compact K in a finite-dimensional normed space E, so the Lean statement is the paper's for every slow parameter at once once K is taken to be I × [-1,1].
